document.description: A certificate of incorporation: a PDF's file name under the server's --documents directory.

as_of.description: The review date (YYYY-MM-DD). A filing date after it is in the future.

is_certificate.description: Is the document in <page> a certificate of incorporation or articles of incorporation filed with a US state's filing office (not an IRS letter, a bank letter or another kind of document)?

looks_altered.description: Does <page> show signs that someone edited the document after it was issued: a field covered over or pasted on, a date typed over another, a box with a visible edge or shadow, or a value misaligned or in a different typeface from the text around it?

signature_present.description: Is there a signature (handwritten or script) on every signature line in <page>?

date_not_future.description: Is every filing, notice or execution date shown in <page> on or before the date in `as_of`?

steps.label: apply_thresholds

body.label: valid
body.code: (s) => ({ document: s.pages.name, verdict: "valid", reasons: [], probabilities: s.triage.p })

body.label: invalid
body.code: (s) => ({ document: s.pages.name, verdict: "invalid", reasons: s.triage.failed, probabilities: s.triage.p })
